message.content: {"issues":[{"clause":null,"kind":"missing_case","note":"The policy does not say how to handle an invoice whose period partly overlaps work already paid, creating a risk of duplicate payment for the overlapping days.","suggestion":"Add: “For an invoice period that partly overlaps work already paid, exclude the previously paid days and process only the unpaid days, subject to the other policy rules.”"},{"clause":6,"kind":"ambiguous","note":"The 60-day receipt deadline does not say whether a late invoice must be rejected or may still be paid.","suggestion":"Replace with: “Invoices received more than 60 days after the end of the billing period will not be paid.”"},{"clause":7,"kind":"ambiguous","note":"The policy does not specify whether a manager must sign off on out-of-scope work before it is performed or may approve it afterward.","suggestion":"Replace with: “Work outside the contractor’s scope of work requires the manager’s written sign-off before the work is performed to be eligible for payment.”"}]}
